summary: The agent implements a sophisticated solution with thorough data cleaning, advanced feature engineering, and a tuned ensemble of gradient boosted trees and a PyTorch neural network. However, the solution suffers from critical data leakage. The agent uses standard randomized K-Fold cross-validation on time-series data (FM05), and explicitly engineers features that look into the future (leads, centered rolling windows) or leak information across the train/test boundary by computing rolling statistics on a combined dataset.
